title: The Slice of Seed Cake
youtube_title: The Slice of Seed Cake | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A smaller piece, fairly given, can still be enough.
summary: At a bakery counter on a soft, busy morning, Remy sees that a slice of seed cake on a green plate will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Remy makes a smaller, even share so Gio is included, and Ms. Okonkwo lets the choice stand without a speech.
